Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids

The Silence-Bubble Generator creates an energy sphere that dampens sound waves. The apparatus is originally marketed as a way for music lovers to enjoy their favorite music without being disturbed by noise. However, spies and crime lords also find the generator useful. Activating the Silence-Bubble Generator is a Standard Action. The bubble covers all squares within 3 squares of the Droid. Any attempt to hear anything inside the bubble by someone outside of the bubble takes a -10 penalty to Perception checks.
system.source: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids
